item.title: Aggregate reports by account and currency
item.brief: Implement the shared contract for reports: accept legacy CSV without currency as USD, validate currency codes when present, aggregate by account and currency, output required header and sort order, malformed currency stderr/status 2. Update README. Keep existing tests passing and add/update tests for new behavior. Run python3 -m unittest. Commit the changes in this repository.

pr.body: Updated reports.py to default absent currency headers to USD, validate three uppercase ASCII letters, aggregate by account/currency, and emit CSV output in the required sorted order. README documents the contract. Tests cover legacy CSV, mixed currencies and sorting, and invalid codes. `python3 -m unittest` passed (3 tests); `git diff --check` passed. Assumption: only a missing currency column defaults to USD; a present but empty currency value is malformed.
pr.summary: Reports now aggregate separately by account and currency, while legacy CSV without currency remains USD. Before: account totals only; now: account,currency,total_cents in account/currency order with invalid currency rejected.

item.title: Add currency column and validation to ledger TSV-to-CSV
item.brief: Implement the shared contract for ledger: parse optional fourth TSV currency field, default to USD, validate exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, emit the new CSV header and currency for each row, and report malformed currency with line number on stderr/status 2 while retaining status 1 for all other input errors. Update README. Keep existing tests passing and add/update tests for new behavior. Run cargo test. Commit the changes in this repository.
